/interface ethernet switch
set switch1 l3-hw-offloading=yes
/interface ethernet switch l3hw-settings
set autorestart=yes ipv6-hw=yes
/interface bridge
add name=bridge protocol-mode=rstp priority=0x1000 vlan-filtering=yes
add name=loopback
/interface ethernet
set [ find default-name=qsfp28-1-1 ] comment="Core switch"
set [ find default-name=qsfp28-2-1 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-1 ] comment="Bond member"
set [ find default-name=sfp28-2 ] comment="Bond member"
set [ find default-name=sfp28-3 ] comment=Host
set [ find default-name=sfp28-4 ] comment="Lab switch that must not join our spanning tree"
set [ find default-name=sfp28-5 ] auto-negotiation=no comment="A 10G optic in a 25G cage" speed=10G-baseSR-LR
set [ find default-name=sfp28-6 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-7 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-8 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-9 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-10 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-11 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-12 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=ether1 ] comment=Out-of-band
/interface ethernet switch port
set sfp28-3 limit-broadcasts=yes limit-unknown-multicasts=yes limit-unknown-unicasts=no storm-rate=5
/interface bonding
add comment="Upstream bond" mode=802.3ad name=uplink slaves="sfp28-1,sfp28-2" transmit-hash-policy=layer-2-and-3
/interface vlan
add interface=bridge name=management vlan-id=10
add interface=bridge l3-hw-offloading=no name=servers vlan-id=20
add interface=bridge name=guests-vlan vlan-id=30
/interface macvlan
add interface=guests-vlan mac-address=02:00:00:00:00:30 name=guests
/interface vrrp
add interface=management name=management-vrrp1 preemption-mode=yes priority=200 vrid=1
/interface bridge port
add bridge=bridge frame-types=admit-only-vlan-tagged interface=qsfp28-1-1 path-cost=100
add bridge=bridge edge=yes frame-types=admit-only-untagged-and-priority-tagged interface=sfp28-3 pvid=20
add bridge=bridge frame-types=admit-only-untagged-and-priority-tagged interface=sfp28-4 pvid=30
add bridge=bridge frame-types=admit-only-untagged-and-priority-tagged interface=sfp28-5 pvid=30
/interface bridge vlan
add bridge=bridge comment=Management tagged="bridge,qsfp28-1-1" vlan-ids=10
add bridge=bridge tagged="bridge,qsfp28-1-1" vlan-ids=20
add bridge=bridge tagged="bridge,qsfp28-1-1" vlan-ids=30
/interface bridge filter
add action=drop chain=input comment="sfp28-4 out of spanning tree" dst-mac-address=01:80:C2:00:00:00/FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF in-interface=sfp28-4
add action=drop chain=output comment="sfp28-4 out of spanning tree" dst-mac-address=01:80:C2:00:00:00/FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF out-interface=sfp28-4
/interface list
add name=lldp
add name=native
/interface list member
add interface=management list=lldp
add interface=qsfp28-1-1 list=lldp
add interface=management list=native
/ip vrf
add comment="Kept apart from everything else" interfaces=guests name=guests
/ip address
add address=198.51.100.2/30 comment=Out-of-band interface=ether1
add address=203.0.113.2/30 comment="Upstream bond" interface=uplink
add address=192.0.2.255/32 interface=loopback
add address=192.0.2.1/24 interface=management
add address=192.0.2.254/32 comment="VRRP 1 on management" interface=management-vrrp1
add address=198.51.100.65/26 interface=servers
add address=198.51.100.129/26 interface=guests
/ipv6 address
add address=2001:db8:20::1/64 advertise=yes interface=servers
/ip pool
add name=servers ranges=198.51.100.100-198.51.100.120
/ip dhcp-server
add address-pool=servers interface=servers lease-time=1h name=servers
/ip dhcp-server network
add address=198.51.100.64/26 dns-server=192.0.2.53 gateway=198.51.100.65
/ip dhcp-relay
add dhcp-server=198.51.100.66 interface=guests name=guests
/ip dns
set allow-remote-requests=yes servers=192.0.2.53
/ip firewall address-list
# generated upstream-origins
add address=192.0.2.0/24 list=management
add address=198.51.100.0/24 list=ours
add address=198.51.100.0/24 list=bgp-networks-v4
/ip firewall filter
add action=accept chain=input comment=Established connection-state="established,related"
add action=accept chain=input comment=Management src-address-list=management
add action=accept chain=input comment=BGP dst-port=179 protocol=tcp src-address=203.0.113.1/32
add action=accept chain=input comment=OSPF protocol=ospf
add action=accept chain=input comment=VRRP protocol=vrrp
add action=drop chain=input comment=Default
add action=fasttrack-connection chain=forward comment=Established connection-state="established,related"
add action=accept chain=forward comment=Established connection-state="established,related"
/ip firewall nat
add action=masquerade chain=srcnat comment="Guests out" out-interface=uplink src-address=198.51.100.128/26
add action=dst-nat to-addresses=198.51.100.70 to-ports=80 chain=dstnat comment="Web server" dst-port=8080 in-interface=uplink protocol=tcp
/ipv6 firewall filter
add action=accept chain=input comment=Established connection-state="established,related"
add action=accept chain=input comment=OSPF protocol=ospf
add action=accept chain=input comment=VRRP protocol=vrrp
add action=drop chain=input comment=Default
add action=accept chain=forward comment=Established connection-state="established,related"
/ip firewall service-port
set ftp disabled=no
set tftp disabled=yes
set irc disabled=yes
set h323 disabled=yes
set sip disabled=yes
set pptp disabled=yes
set rtsp disabled=yes
/interface ethernet switch rule
add comment="Drop spoofed" mac-protocol=ip new-dst-ports="" ports=qsfp28-1-1 src-address=198.51.100.0/255.255.255.0 switch=switch1
add comment="Cap UDP" mac-protocol=ip ports=qsfp28-1-1 protocol=udp rate=1.0Gbps switch=switch1
add comment="sfp28-3 takes ipv4" mac-protocol=ip ports=sfp28-3 switch=switch1
add comment="sfp28-3 takes ipv6" mac-protocol=ipv6 ports=sfp28-3 switch=switch1
add comment="sfp28-3 takes arp" mac-protocol=arp ports=sfp28-3 switch=switch1
add comment="sfp28-3 takes nothing else" new-dst-ports="" ports=sfp28-3 switch=switch1
/ip route
add comment=Upstream dst-address=0.0.0.0/0 gateway=203.0.113.1
add blackhole comment=Originate dst-address=198.51.100.0/24
add comment="Guest exit" dst-address=0.0.0.0/0 gateway=198.51.100.130 routing-table=guests
/routing rpki
add address=192.0.2.80 group=rpki port=323
/routing bgp instance
add as=64500 name=default router-id=192.0.2.255
/routing filter rule
add chain=UPSTREAM-IN-V4 comment=Blackhole rule="if (dst in ours && bgp-large-communities includes 64500:666:0) { set blackhole yes; accept }"
add chain=UPSTREAM-IN-V4 comment="Only the default route" rule="if (dst==0.0.0.0/0) { set bgp-local-pref 200; append bgp-large-communities 64500:1:1; set pref-src 192.0.2.255; accept }"
add chain=UPSTREAM-IN-V4 comment="The upstream's own customers" rule="if (bgp-path-len>0 && bgp-path-len<3) { accept }"
add chain=UPSTREAM-IN-V4 rule=reject
add chain=UPSTREAM-OUT-V4 comment="Not to upstreams" rule="if (bgp-large-communities includes 64500:100:0) { reject }"
add chain=UPSTREAM-OUT-V4 rule="set bgp-communities 64501:100; delete bgp-large-communities regexp \"^64500:[0-9]+:[0-9]+\$\""
add chain=UPSTREAM-OUT-V4 comment="Our space" rule="rpki-verify rpki; if (dst in ours && rpki valid) { set bgp-med 10; set bgp-path-prepend 1; accept }"
add chain=UPSTREAM-OUT-V4 rule=reject
/routing bgp connection
add as=64500 input.filter=UPSTREAM-IN-V4 instance=default input.limit-process-routes-ipv4=10 local.role=ebgp-customer name=upstream-1 output.filter-chain=UPSTREAM-OUT-V4 output.network=bgp-networks-v4 remote.address=203.0.113.1/32 remote.as=64501 use-bfd=yes
add as=64500 hold-time=1m30s input.filter=UPSTREAM-IN-V4 instance=default keepalive-time=30s local.address=192.0.2.255 local.role=ibgp multihop=yes name=internal output.filter-chain=UPSTREAM-OUT-V4 output.network=bgp-networks-v4 remote.address=192.0.2.254/32 remote.as=64500 use-bfd=yes
/routing ospf instance
add name=ospf-v2 redistribute="connected,static" router-id=192.0.2.255 version=2
/routing ospf area
add area-id=0.0.0.0 instance=ospf-v2 name=ospf-v2-0.0.0.0
/routing ospf interface-template
add passive area=ospf-v2-0.0.0.0 interfaces=management
add area=ospf-v2-0.0.0.0 cost=10 interfaces=uplink type=ptp use-bfd=yes
/routing bfd configuration
add interfaces=all min-rx=300ms min-tx=300ms multiplier=4
add addresses=192.0.2.254/32 min-rx=300ms min-tx=300ms multiplier=4
